item.title: Python library for MarketWatch virtual trading
item.description: I wanted to automate chores in MarketWatch’s virtual stock game (paper trading, not a real broker). marketwatch[1] on PyPI is the small client I shipped — watchlists, game state, portfolio, orders, leaderboard.
